flows.description: Transmission: susceptible individuals become infected (enter latent stage E₁) at rate λ(t) proportional to β and infectious population.
Latent progression E₁→E₂ at daily rate σ.
Latent progression E₂→I₁ at daily rate σ.
Infectious stage progression I₁→I₂ at daily rate γ.
Recovery/removal I₂→R at daily rate γ.

parameters.description: Constant transmission rate (rate at which new infections take place given a contact); used in force of infection λ(t) proportional to infectious people.
Force of infection (rate at which a susceptible becomes infected), assumed proportional to number of infectious people at time t and transmission rate β (homogeneous mixing).
Daily rate of transition E₁→E₂ and E₂→I₁; implies average incubation period d_L = 2*(1/σ) days.
Daily rate of transition I₁→I₂ and I₂→R; implies average infectious period d_I = 2*(1/γ) days.
Initial susceptibility (proportion non-immune at start); used in effective reproduction number R_n together with epidemic growth rate parameter ψ.
Initial infection rate / initial force of infection parameter at epidemic start (as used in parameter set Θ_T = (π, λ₀, ψ, σ, γ)).
Epidemic growth-related parameter (EGR parametrisation); used with π to determine effective reproduction number R_n.
Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection.
Mean of Gamma-distributed waiting time from infection to ICU/HDU admission.
Variance of Gamma-distributed waiting time from infection to ICU/HDU admission.
Negative Binomial dispersion parameter for weekly ICU/HDU admission counts (observation model).
Basic reproduction number; discussed with plausible range 1≤R₀≤4 used to set priors (no explicit formula given in provided sections).
Effective reproduction number in partially immune population; stated to be a function of susceptibility π and EGR parameter ψ (explicit formula not provided in provided sections).
Total Attack Rate: probability of being infected over the whole epidemic for a susceptible individual (computed from transmission model; explicit formula not provided in provided sections).
